In particular, the Tool incorporates a feature for the calculation of Indicator 2.c.1, which measures the number of “Price Anomalies” that occur on a given food commodity price series over a given period of time and is being used to measure progress towards Target 2.c.

name: FormSG
project_description: SDG INDICATOR 16.6.1 - Governmental expenditures within budgets FormSG as an open source government form builder provides access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels. FormSG is used for government application forms, and also as a reporting and feedback platform by various public agencies. SDG INDICATOR 16.6.2 - Satisfaction with public services We gather feedback from our members of public using FormSG and have gotten an average satisfaction rating of 4.66 out of 5 over 69,140 feedback submitted.

name: Ghost
project_description: We build free open source software to provide modern journalists with the technology needed to run an independent news organisation — from publishing, to distribution, subscriptions, and payments. We believe that sustainable media is vital to sustainable democracy, and our product is designed to help news organisations not just survive, but thrive, within an information ecosystem that's moving faster than ever. To date, our product has generated revenue exceeding $100M for independent publishers, in support of this mission. Target 16.10: Ensure public access to information and protect fundamental freedoms: By offering a platform that is not controlled by centralized algorithms or corporate interests, Ghost protects the freedom of expression and ensures that diverse, independent voices have the tools to provide public access to information.

name: Global Healthsites Mapping Project
project_description: In a time of crisis, such as the COVID-19 disease outbreak, there is a rush to establish accurate health care location data that can be used to support people on the ground. This has been demonstrated by events such as the Haiti earthquake and the Ebola epidemic in West Africa. As a result valuable time is wasted establishing accurate and accessible baseline data. Healthsites.io establishes this data and the tools necessary to upload, manage and make the data easily accessible

name: Global Open Facility Registry
project_description: GOFR’s objective is to enable integrated and interoperable Master Facility Registries (MFR) across health information systems, in line with target 3.8 - Achieve universal health coverage. It also helps to improve accuracy, compare data sets and create master lists of facilities for health, education, and agriculture applications.

name: GlobaLeaks
project_description: GlobaLeaks is a free and open-source whistleblowing software enabling everyone to report safely and anonymously about wrongdoings encountered during their own life and work experience. The technology has already enabled worldwide more than 20,000 organizations to create projects focused on anti-corruption, gender-based violence, environmental crimes, war crimes. The digital solution also aligns with SDG 16, Target 16.10: Ensure public access to information and protect fundamental freedoms.

name: Govdirectory
project_description: Our vision is "Our vision is a world where people are empowered to engage with their government to ensure responsive, inclusive, participatory and representative decision-making at all levels." and our mission is "We will enable a community powered directory where the online presence of every public organization is easily findable, queryable and trustworthy.". Together, they are directly related to target 16.7 and 16.8.

name: HCW@Home
project_description: HCW@Home is a specialized tele-consultation platform designed for NGOs, healthcare providers, and hospitals. It facilitates telemedicine care in various scenarios via secure messaging, voice, and video communication. Proven effective by multinational NGOs and top-tier hospitals, this solution supports Sustainable Development Goals by offering comprehensive, integrated telemedicine services to remote populations lacking access to doctors.

name: IATI Data
project_description: IATI data is most directly linked to SDG 17, which focuses on strengthening the means of implementation and revitalizing the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development. Target 17.1: Strengthen domestic resource mobilization - IATI data provides information on international support, which helps developing countries track incoming resources. This transparency aids in budgeting and resource management. Target 17.3: Mobilize additional financial resources for developing countries - By making development finance data publicly available, IATI helps track financial flows from various sources, including official development assistance (ODA), and encourages additional mobilization from diverse actors.

name: if me
project_description: It is most relevant to Goal 3 of the Sustainable Development Goals, Good Health and Well-Being (Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages). Created in 2014, if-me.org is a free, open source mental health communication platform to share experiences with loved ones. Through our platform and blog, we center marginalized communities that have little or no access to mental health education, resources, and services — including refugee and immigrant communities and communities of color. Our app is translated to various languages, including Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese, Dutch, English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, and Vietnamese. Our contributor community is well-known for being inclusive with hundreds of developers, designers, writers, and advocates from around the world, from non-traditional backgrounds in open source and technology. Our project’s creator, Julia Nguyen has given keynote talks about it at Open Source Bridge, AnxietyTech, Write/Speak/Code, and the Mental Health Association of San Francisco. We were featured on the Code Newbies Podcast and the Huffington Post Blog. We’ve mentored women developers through a paid internship program that Rails Girls Summer of Code has organized.

name: iHRIS
project_description: Countries use it to capture and maintain high-quality information for health workforce planning, management, regulation, and training for improved health outcomes.

name: Immunization Calculation Engine
project_description: ICE promotes best practices for immunization to ensure that infectious diseases that can be controlled through vaccination are contained, in line with target 3.8 Achieve universal health coverage

name: Indonesian Phoneme Recognizer
project_description: The main purpose of developing our Indonesian phoneme recognizer is to create an automated recognizer that could accurately transcribe phonemes of Indonesian children's speech as they learn to read. Children would read books aloud, get their speech transcribed, and obtain real-time feedback on their pronunciation. This is one core component of the development of our larger solution, Bookbot, which aims to teach literacy to Indonesian children in a fun, engaging, and self-learning fashion. One of our goals is to provide equal quality education, specifically on literacy, to all Indonesian children regardless of where and who they are -- all in a mobile app that runs offline and in real-time.

name: Isomer
project_description: SDG INDICATOR 16.6.2: Isomer facilitates public access to information and empowers government agencies to provide information to citizens so they can be aware of public service activities and be able to determine how satisfactory they are and provide informed feedback to relevant agencies. SDG INDICATOR 16.10.2: Isomer empowers government agencies to create and maintain transparent, accessible, and user-friendly websites, which supports the development of accountable institutions. By enabling easy communication with citizens and providing access to information, it helps meet the goal of ensuring public access to information and enhancing transparency in governance.

name: iVerify
project_description: iVerify is a fact-checking digital product which combats the spread of false narratives during election periods by combining new technology like AI and machine learning with human-supported fact-checking. Developed by UNDP through the Brussels-based Task Force on Electoral Assistance and the Chief Digital Office, the platform has been piloted in Zambia, ahead of the historic August 2021 general elections, and first used in the general election in Honduras November 2021. By mid 2024, iVerify has been deployed in Pakistan, Sierra Leone, Madagascar, Democratic Republic of Congo, Nigeria, and North Macedonia.

name: Janssen Project
project_description: Governments are implementing digital identity to increase access to services using the Web and mobile applications. Effective registration, authentication and account recovery are critical identity journeys to rollout at scale. Both the public and private sector needs digital identity infrastructure to effectively organize, and in fact to build the digital societies of the future. Furthermore, digital identity extends to software. Increasing, we are seeing the criticality of "machine-to-machine" security. The Janssen Project platform also provides tools to build security between both public and private sector institutions and organizations.
